# idea-capture


Investigate a topic using web search, codegraph, and codebase analysis — shows findings, classifies by PARA destination, saves with metadata for downstream consumption. When invoked without input, lists existing researched drafts for review and promotion.



## Triggers

- investigar

- research

- buscar

- investiga esto

- buscar sobre

- investigados

- researched

- listar investigados

- mostrar investigados

- drafts investigados

- pick draft

- elegir draft

- promover draft

- validar draft




## What I do

- Investigate a topic using web search, GitHub search, codegraph, codebase analysis, graphify, and Context7 documentation

- Create research drafts with metadata (PARA destination, status, tags) in Obsidian vault

- List existing researched drafts for review, enrichment, and promotion

- Promote drafts from researched to validated, or demote back to raw




## Usage examples

- Investigar un tema nuevo y guardar el resultado como draft

- Listar drafts investigados y promoverlos a validated

- Research a topic using web search and codebase analysis
